text:
Ada: Heads-up — planning to cut v2.14 to prod tonight at 21:00 UTC. Can owners acknowledge and confirm smoke/rollback owners?

Matt: I can run the smoke suite and monitor the smoke dashboard. Plan: 1% canary for 15m, then 10% for 15m if healthy. Abort criteria: error rate > 1% OR p95 latency +200ms.

Sasha: I pushed the final config tweak for the sampling window, PR #3421 is merged to main. I'll handle the feature-flag toggle during the canary.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window reserved for 2026-05-12 21:00 UTC. I will post a 15m reminder and the deployment link.

Oliver: Rollback owner here — I'll own rollback and verification. Runbook: /runbooks/rollbacks/inference-rollback.md. If we hit the abort criteria I'll trigger the traffic switch back to v2.13 and invalidate caches.

Priya: Canary smoke checklist (quick):
- healthcheck endpoint (200/ok)
- sample generation test (10 prompts, baseline BLEU/latency)
- tracing/span validation attached to requests
- KV cache flush sanity
I'll run these during the 1% window and report results.

Matt: Small note — no DB migrations in this deploy, so no dry-run needed. Also prepping synthetic load to simulate 50rps for the canary.

Ada: Please ensure fallback routing is set: rollout.fallback: v2.13 and region routing pinned to us-west-2 for the first 30m. Sasha — ping me when flag is ready to toggle.

Sasha: Flag is ready. I'll toggle at T+5m into the 1% canary to validate config propagation. I'll post the exact CLI I run.

Oliver: Confirmed on-call and pager ready. If I roll back, I'll run: `infra route set inference-service --variant v2.13 --reason "canary abort"` and then follow the runbook validation steps.

Ada: All right — acked by owners. Unless anyone posts a -1, we proceed. Final freeze for changes at 20:30 UTC. I'll send the 15m reminder at 20:45.

Matt: ACK.

Priya: ACK.

Sasha: ACK.

Oliver: ACK.

Ada: Thanks team — see you in the deploy thread.
